initial_rules: FAIL any visible scratch, stain, or surface damage; PASS otherwise.
final_rules: FAIL any visible scratch, stain, or surface damage; PASS otherwise.

rounds.rules: Inspect the full cable cross-section including outer sheath, inner insulation and copper strands against the reference. PASS only when all surfaces are clean and uniform except for normal plastic texture and expected lighting reflections and glare that match the reference in location and appearance. FAIL for any visible scratch, stain, discoloration, surface damage, dark speck, spot, particle, thin dark line, fiber, smudge or foreign mark on or across the cable, even if small, faint, at the edge of the part, or extending onto the background. Do not excuse small specks as normal texture, thin lines crossing different materials or background as dust or camera artifacts, or small bottom/edge marks as overlay graphics - if the mark is clearly visible and not present identically in the reference, FAIL it.
rounds.rationale: Narrowed PASS to only reference-matched texture and reflections to prevent false alarms, and explicitly required FAIL for small specks, thin lines crossing materials/background, and edge marks previously excused as texture, dust, or graphics to fix repeated false PASS verdicts.
